# Load raw data

```{r}
#load libraries
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(here)
```

```{r}
# Dynamically load the Excel file with "here"
raw_file_path <- here("data", "_raw", "AP_cohort_COVID_1_raw.xlsx")
sheets <- excel_sheets(raw_file_path)


sheet_list <- map(sheets, 
                  ~ read_xlsx(raw_file_path, 
                              sheet = .x))
names(sheet_list) <- sheets
```

```{r}
#create tsv-files from nested tibble
dir.create("data/sheets_tsv")
out_dir <- here("data", "sheets_tsv")

imap(sheet_list, 
     function(df, sheet_name) {
  out_file <- here(out_dir, paste0(sheet_name, ".tsv"))
  write_tsv(df, out_file)
})
```

```{r}
#Extract multimer frequencies (AG7 per sheet)

get_multimer_freq <- function(sh) {
  # Try reading the single cell AG7 for this sheet
  cell_tbl <- tryCatch(
    read_xlsx(
      raw_file_path,
      sheet = sh,
      range = "AG7",
      col_names = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      # If the sheet doesn't have that range at all, return empty tibble
      tibble()
    }
  )
  
  # If there are no columns, AG7 doesn't exist on this sheet
  if (ncol(cell_tbl) == 0) {
    mf_val <- NA_real_
  } else {
    raw_val <- cell_tbl |> pull(1)
    
    # Clean value: remove % sign and whitespace, then convert to numeric
    cleaned <- raw_val |>
      str_replace_all("%", "") |>
      str_trim()
    
    mf_val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cleaned))
  }
  
  tibble(
    sheet = sh,
    multimer_frequency = mf_val
  )
}

multimer_freq_df <- map_dfr(sheets, get_multimer_freq)
multimer_freq_df
```

### Read TSVs and keep only needed columns

```{r}
tsv_files <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

get_sheet_name <- function(path) {
  basename(path) |> str_remove("\\.tsv$")
}

all_peptides <- map_dfr(tsv_files, function(f) {
  df <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
  sheet_name <- get_sheet_name(f)
  
  df |>
    # make sure we always have a sample + sheet column
    mutate(
      sheet  = sheet_name,
      sample = if ("sample" %in% names(df)) sample else sheet_name
    ) |>
    # keep ONLY the columns you care about
    select(
      sheet,
      sample,
      any_of(c(
        "count.1",
        "input.1", "input.2", "input.3",
        "log_fold_change",
        "p",
        "HLA",
        "Protein",
        "Peptide"
      ))
    )
})
```

### Join multimer frequency per sheet

```{r}
peptides_with_mf <- all_peptides |>
  left_join(multimer_freq_df, by = "sheet")

```

### Create HLA_Peptide, Response, and Est.frequency

```{r}
peptides_final <- peptides_with_mf |>
  mutate(
    # HLA–peptide combo
    HLA_Peptide = paste(HLA, Peptide, sep = "_"),
    
    # Response flag: log_fold_change > 2 and p < 0.05
    Response = log_fold_change > 2 & p < 0.05,
    mutate(Response = if_else(Response, 1L, 0L))
  ) |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  mutate(
    # sum of count.1 only among responses within each sample
    total_count_responses = sum(count.1[Response], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Est.frequency = count.1 / sum(count.1 for responses) * multimer_frequency
    Est.frequency = if_else(
      Response &
        total_count_responses > 0 &
        !is.na(multimer_frequency),
      count.1 / total_count_responses * multimer_frequency,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

```

### Final selection and save

```{r}
peptides_out <- peptides_final |>
  select(
    sample,
    count.1,
    `input.1`, `input.2`, `input.3`,
    log_fold_change,
    p,
    HLA,
    Protein,
    Peptide,
    HLA_Peptide,
    Response,
    Est.frequency
  )

dir.create(here("data", "clean"), showWarnings = FALSE)

write_tsv(
  peptides_out,
  here("data", "clean", "peptides_master.tsv")
)

```
